Class KeyBindings.UpdatedJ3Key

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.input.keyboard.KeyBindings.UpdatedJ3Key
Enclosing class:
KeyBindings
public static class KeyBindings.UpdatedJ3Key extends Object
UpdatedJ3Key is a return object of KeyBindings.rebindJ3KeyKeystroke(KeyStroke, J3Key) which represents the result of the update.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
